description: One process per cluster, supervised by Distributor, pid fills every uncovered shard_materializers slot. Speaks Materializer read API (get/get_range with version+opts) so StorageRacing/clients are unchanged. Parks per-tag in WaitingList (budget min(client timeout, hold_ms)); signals {:coverage_demand, tag} to Distributor (deduped); on {:covered, tag, pid} drains queue by re-issuing; sheds {:error, :unavailable} at budget; forwards (not parks) when a live pid is known — staleness shim. Wire deadline expiry properly (lesson: bedrock-tvb).

comments.text: From q67.1 audit: (1) when placeholder ships, narrow StorageRacing's blanket rescue RuntimeError — it mislabels any RuntimeError from an in-process operation_fn (cached-fastest path) as layout_lookup_failed; wrap only lookup_key! or use a dedicated exception. (2) Consider an invariant check/assertion that a healthy TSL never yields []-pid segments once placeholder fills all slots. (3) Doc nit: lookup_key!/lookup_range @docs should state pids may be [] for uncovered shards.

title: Placeholder materializer: fallback coverage endpoint with bounded parking
